title: Missing-benchmark-run declaration guard
impact: Measurement-only CI guardrail: `generate_history.dart` now fails the build when a chartable (accepted/in-review) experiment numbered `≥ 178` has no linked benchmark run *and* no `**Benchmark Run:**` opt-out declaration — converting the documented silent chart-invisibility failure (forgotten result file / date mismatch) into a loud error for new work. Reuses the existing `_skipsReleaseBenchmarkRunMapping` opt-out signal as the escape hatch; pre-178 experiments are grandfathered. No runtime code; `history.json` byte-for-byte unchanged
